blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Mimaropa police recorded zero crime incidents across the provinces of Occidental and Oriental Mindoro, Marinduque, Romblon, and Palawan during the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, according to Police Brig. Gen. Christopher R. Dela Cruz, regional police director, in a statement on Tuesday (Nov. 3). Beyond the holiday success, the region also posted a notable 11.74 percent drop in total crime incidents for the period May 8 to November 3, compared to the same period last year — falling from 3,050 to 2,692 cases, or 358 fewer incidents.
